about: Music production brief: one continuous 100-second score for the approved V4 picture lock. The founder's voice is always dominant.

deliverable.start: sample-accurate at 0.000 s (the film's first frame)
deliverable.end: fully silent from 98.6 s to 100.0 s
deliverable.loudness: score alone: about −16 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP (the film applies −7 dB and ducks −9 dB under every voice line)

reference.video: out/navislabs-v4-picture-lock-1080p.mp4 (temp voice and temp score; mute the temp score while composing)

voice_first: The founder's voice is always dominant: leave 120–350 Hz and 2–4 kHz open while he speaks.
No lead melody under a voice line; state the motif between lines.
Ducking is automatic: −9 dB under each line (attack 0.15 s, release 0.5 s). Write so the ducked score still sounds intentional.
forbidden: 'AI' clichés: fast glittery arpeggios, robotic vocoder
a hit on the NavisLabs reveal

sections.brief: restrained, almost silent: a low bed; the NavisLabs reveal at 10.5 s is carried by silence and one tonal SFX
sections.instrumentation: A low, soft bed (sustained low strings or a warm synth pad, very quiet); no pulse, no melody. Distant, sparse glints at most.
sections.relative_level: −30 to −24 dB relative to full score level
sections.picture: The voice opens the film over near-silence. At 10.0–10.45 s everything stops (full rest): the NavisLabs mark arrives on silence plus one tonal SFX. Do not score the reveal with a hit.

sections.brief: subtle brand emergence under the products and the data flow
sections.instrumentation: A gentle harmonic opening under the two products and the light data-flow world: a soft motif (2–4 notes) introduced on piano or mallet, a slow pad lift. Allow a very light pulse from ~14.3 s (the wipe to light).
sections.picture: Infrastructure, not spectacle: the pipeline builds stage by stage; let the music breathe with it. No riser into 22 s.

picture_anchors.picture: wipe to the light data-flow world

sections.brief: human / organizational: warm, unhurried, the person's decision
sections.instrumentation: Warm and unhurried: piano, soft strings or warm pads; the motif becomes human. Light movement, no driving rhythm.
sections.picture: A person's day: Today, why, the draft, a human edit. Full rest on Approve & send (40.95–41.2 s), then a small, warm resolution as the reply is sent (42.8 s).

sections.brief: technical developer momentum: precise, light rhythm
sections.instrumentation: Precise, light rhythm (muted plucks, soft arpeggio, restrained electronic pulse ~100–108 BPM feel); bass enters gently. Clean and modern, never aggressive.
sections.picture: Terminal, MCP, context, SDK, API, permissions, the run. Pull right back (−18 dB) under the refusal 60.9–62.1 s — quieter, not tense. Lighter again for the solo developer from 66.6 s.

sections.brief: convergence: the human and technical motifs meet; shared understanding
sections.instrumentation: The human motif and the technical pulse meet: the warm harmony returns over a softened pulse. By 73.4 s (One organization) both motifs are present.
sections.picture: Same facts, same sources, same freshness (77.7–79.9 s): keep the music steady with no accents — the voice and the macro cuts carry it.

sections.brief: conviction / moat: steady, grounded, no riser
sections.instrumentation: Grounded and steady: sustained harmony, a slow, confident pulse; the motif stated once, simply. No riser, no drum build.
sections.picture: Models change, agents change, tools change; the company keeps its history. Confidence through restraint.

picture_anchors.picture: cut: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.

sections.brief: resolution under the end card, then silence
sections.instrumentation: One resolving chord or the motif's last statement under the end card; decay naturally to silence.
sections.picture: The end lockup lands at 94.0 s; the score must be fully silent from 98.6 s to 100.0 s.

sync_points.music: silence; the bed may enter softly under V01 (0.6 s)
no hit; the tonal SFX carries it; the score re-enters softly after
M2 emergence begins around here (brief: 12 s)

sync_points.picture: wipe to the light data-flow world
sync_points.music: gentle lift allowed; no whoosh, no hit
M3 human texture by 22.6 s (brief: 22 s)
M4 technical momentum from here (brief: 45 s)
optional subtle accent, under −6 dB relative
score −18 dB until 62.1 s; no tension cue
start bringing the human motif back over the pulse

sync_points.picture: cut: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.

tempo: Score to picture, not to a grid: picture events are not on a beat grid. A ~100–108 BPM feel suits 45–68 s; elsewhere free time or very slow pulse.
status: brief only — the final score is not generated. A temp score that follows this arc plays in the current cut.
